chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام.
The limit for the one who has despaired of menstruation is fifty years.

key_terms.حَدُّ: the legal limit or defining threshold
key_terms.يَئِسَتْ: has despaired; no longer expects menstruation

ai.seo_question: At what age is a woman considered to have despaired of menstruation according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the age at which a woman is considered to have despaired of menstruation. It identifies that threshold as fifty years, and it relates to jurisprudential discussions of menstruation and associated rulings.
